tiers.1: Verified in CI on every change, or on a named device on a fixed cadence where CI cannot run it.
tiers.2: Verified on a reference device before each release.
tiers.3: Best effort. It builds or loads, but no promise, and a defect there does not block a release.

tables.title: Codecs
notes: Device- and browser-dependent cells are resolved at runtime by capability queries; Alumbra never offers a rendition the device cannot decode.

tables.title: Text tracks
notes: ASS / SSA is rendered by Alumbra's own C++ subset renderer on every platform, with no libass or LGPL dependency (ADR-0035). Coverage is a defined supported subset, and fidelity for karaoke, transforms and drawings is weaker than libass.

tables.title: Ads
notes: ⁴ On iPhone Safari, only `<video>` can enter native fullscreen and HTML overlays are dropped; Alumbra uses CSS pseudo-fullscreen there (D-24, research/ios-fullscreen-and-ima.md). Google also documents that skippable ads and fullscreen do not work together on iPhone.
⁵ The IMA HTML5 SDK exposes no friendly-obstruction API; instead, Alumbra draws no UI over the ad container while an ad plays (D-23).
